# ThreadFX

> Tactile micro-interactions, procedural audio synthesis, and visual particle physics for social feeds — starting with Threads.

ThreadFX is an open-source browser extension and interaction suite that transforms silent social scrolling into a tactile, responsive experience. When users react to or like posts on social feeds, ThreadFX provides instantaneous zero-latency audio synthesis, hardware-accelerated particle physics, and progressive gamified milestones.

## Core Capabilities

- **Zero-Latency Procedural Audio Synthesis**: ThreadFX generates 100% of its sound effects procedurally in-memory using Frank Force's ZzFX engine and the native Web Audio API (`AudioContext`). No external `.mp3`, `.wav`, or `.ogg` files are ever downloaded or streamed.
- **Hardware-Accelerated Particle Physics**: Canvas confetti bursts with customizable color palettes, particle density, velocity, gravity, and emoji glyph modes rendered onto an isolated overlay.
- **Native Chrome Side Panel**: Seamless side panel interface built with React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4, allowing real-time sound preview, volume calibration, pitch adjustment, and palette selection without obstructing the feed.
- **Privacy First & Local Storage**: Minimal Manifest V3 permissions (`sidePanel`, `storage`). All preferences, counters, and cached post IDs are stored strictly in `chrome.storage.local`. Zero telemetry, zero external network tracking, zero analytics scripts.
- **Progressive Milestones**: 7-tier gamified progression system with custom 3D achievement badges celebrating interaction milestones (from Curious Juicer to Omni Deity).

## Technical Architecture

- **Extension Framework**: WXT (Next-gen browser extension framework built on Vite).
- **Manifest Version**: Manifest V3 (MV3).
- **UI Framework**: React 19 + TypeScript.
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 + Radix UI primitives.
- **Audio Synthesis**: Procedural ZzFX Web Audio parameter arrays.
- **Visual Particles**: Canvas-confetti canvas overlays.
- **Web App**: Vite + React 19 landing page with interactive simulator, acoustic waveform visualizer, and live soundboard.
